summary: A3: one anchor mechanism produces supplies (salvage and loot caches), habitat loot tables pay out on victory, and travel is refused when the rations are not there

coordination.notes: A4 places the estate's Infirmary/Workshop/MapTable/Inspect anchors on this same mechanism and deletes rest_at_estate; A3 deliberately leaves rest_at_estate as the single owner of the infirmary rule and has use_anchor call it rather than growing a second copy. godot_bridge.rs is outside this lane's ownership and is edited in exactly one place: expedition_error_code's match is exhaustive over ExpeditionError, so the two new variants (AnchorNotHere, AnchorSpentToday) the A3 card names cannot exist without two new arms there, or cargo check --features godot-ext fails. No other bridge surface is touched; B3 still owns exposing anchors to Godot. backend-p0-unify-expedition-spines is still marked active over expedition.rs/geography.rs, but its reconciliation is already merged into this branch's history (A1 shipped 6b9d275), so this work builds on its result rather than beside it.
